resources.string: Ikheli lokulanda le-GitHub alitholakalanga; zama futhi kamuva.
Le nguqulo ayinikezi ikheli lokulanda le-Lanzou; ungasebenzisa i-GitHub.
Le nguqulo ayinikezi ikheli eliqondile le-APK efanele yile nguqulo; hamba ekhasini le-Release le-GitHub ukhethe i-APK efanele.
Imvume yokuthi “Faka izinhlelo zokusebenza ezingaziwayo” ayinikezwanga, ayikwazi ukufaka ngokuzenzakalela. Hamba ezilungiselelweni zesistimu, vumela, bese uzama futhi.

Isistimu yale divayisi yi-Android 10 nangaphezulu; inguqulo encane ye-Go ayisahambelani, inguqulo endala ayisasebenzi.\n\nKutholakele ukuthi kule divayisi kufakiwe inguqulo evamile (ZLC); yivule ngqo ukuze uqhubeke uyisebenzisa (inguqulo entsha ayisahlinzeki inguqulo ehambelanayo ye-Go; ungayisusa inguqulo endala ukuze ukhulule isikhala).

Isistimu yale divayisi yi-Android 10 nangaphezulu; inguqulo encane ye-Go ayisahambelani, inguqulo endala ayisasebenzi.\nLanda bese ufaka inguqulo evamile ukuze uqhubeke usebenzisa (inguqulo entsha ayisahlinzeki inguqulo ehambelanayo ye-Go).

Ukufaka inguqulo entsha kudinga imvume yesistimu yokuthi “Faka izinhlelo zokusebenza ezingaziwayo”.\n\nUchofoze “Hamba unike imvume”, vumela ezilungiselelweni bese ubuyela ohlelweni; ukufaka kuzoqhubeka ngokuzenzakalela (akudingeki kulandiwe kabusha).
Kuzolandwa bese kufakwa futhi le nguqulo (ibhala phezu kohlelo lamanje).\nLo msebenzi usetshenziswa ukuhlola kabusha indlela yokubuyekeza.
